overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the mayor's text to councilors was one-way, and the pre-meeting contacts among councilors were subquorum, so no deliberation occurred outside a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council deliberated by text message about a proposed holiday trash and recycling fine amnesty before its December 27 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the mayor's text was a one-way communication to the councilors, with no further response or discussion between or among the Council, we find that the Council did not deliberate outside of a meeting.
